description: Create a link to review a lab order on picardo.health for the chosen panels and tests. Nothing is ordered or saved here: the user reviews the order, enters their details and pays on the site. Returns the link, what it contains and anything that could not be included. Orders are for adults 18 and over and are not available to people who live in New York, New Jersey, Rhode Island, Pennsylvania, Maryland, Massachusetts, Hawaii, Maine. picardo.health checks the date of birth and address at checkout and refuses an order from anyone else.
name: prepare_order_link

atHomeDrawUsd.description: At-home blood draw fee for the tests everyone gets: one fee per requisition of up to 40 tests. A Labcorp location is free.

atHomeDrawUsdForMen.description: Set only when a man’s PSA takes the order into another requisition; otherwise null.

atHomeDrawUsdForWomen.description: Set only when a woman’s pregnancy test takes the order into another requisition; otherwise null.

notIncluded.description: Requested IDs or codes that could not be included.

subtotalUsd.description: Price in US dollars of the tests everyone gets, before any blood draw fee. Checkout adds PSA for men and a pregnancy test (hCG) for women. Null when a test is temporarily unavailable.

title: Prepare an order link
